body:
This ticket was authored from a T207 build-lane report claiming CLAUDE.md and
scripts/rails-guard-ci.mjs reference `npm run preflight`. A coldstart judge checked the
premise (2026-08-21): ZERO occurrences on the working tree, on origin/main, and in the entire
history of every ref (`git log --all -S "npm run preflight"` is empty). The only 'preflight'
ever in CLAUDE.md was the ADLC plugin's SessionStart preflight hook, removed in PR #173.

The lane's report was wrong; the doctrine held (grep-verify any report claim that names a
file before passing it upward — the T116 lesson, reproduced). Nothing to build. Archived on
creation day with this note so the record shows the claim was checked, not dropped.

Acceptance criteria:
(a) None — the premise is refuted. Verify: the grep transcript above, re-runnable.

Merge tier: not applicable.
title: REFUTED — no `npm run preflight` reference exists (a lane report error, checked and closed)
